history.recommendation_text: 48. The Board recommends that the Department of Peacekeeping Operations and the Department of Field Support enhance their monitoring function by requesting missions to regularly update the status of environmental focal points.
history.reference_raw: A/71/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the; para. 357
history.administration_response: The Department of Field Support stated that the implementation of the recommendation was in progress. On 16 May 2017, the Office of Military Affairs of the Department of Peacekeeping Operations appointed its Environmental Focal Point. Terms of reference and a command and control structure for mission force headquarters environmental focal points and camp environmental focal points are currently being developed and will be shared with missions, which will be requested to appoint focal points accordingly.

history.recommendation_text: 27. The Board recommends that the Department of Peacekeeping Operations and the Department of Field Support enhance their monitoring function by requesting missions to regularly update the status of environmental focal points. Organizational issues
history.reference_raw: A/71/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the year ended 30 June 2016; para. 357
history.administration_response: The Department of Field Support stated that the recommendation has been implemented. The terms of reference for missions’ Force Headquarters environmental adviser and the sector and camp environmental focal points have been developed. On 27 March 2018, the Military Adviser of the Office of Military Affairs sent a facsimile to all field missions requesting the missions to appoint environmental focal points. All missions have appointed environmental focal points.
